AXT Inc 2023 2024 gross margin decline InP substrate revenue decrease year over year

findings.claim: 2019 下行：全年毛利率由 2018 的 36.2% 降到 29.8%，2020 回升至 31.7%；原因為銷量下滑、製造成本（尤其 GaAs）未同步下降。
findings.excerpt: Gross margin in 2019 was 29.8% as compared to 36.2% in 2018.

findings.claim: 2019 年第四季毛利率低點約 21%，對比 Q1 2019 的 33.1%。
findings.source: AXT 8-K 新聞稿 (SEC 搜尋結果)
findings.excerpt: 21 percent for the fourth quarter of 2019, which compares with 33.1 percent of revenue for the first quarter of 2019.

Gross margin in 2023 was 17.6% as compared to 36.9% in 2022. The decrease in gross profit is attributed to lower revenue resulting in fixed costs being spread over less units and an unfavorable change in product mix.

findings.claim: 2023 北美營收年減 67.7%，主因 InP 與 GaAs 基板需求下滑。
findings.excerpt: Revenue from customers in North America decreased in 2023 by 67.7% primarily due to lower demand for InP wafer substrates and GaAs wafer substrates used in LED and wireless applications

findings.claim: 2025 年 Q1 毛利率 -6.4%、Q2 為 8.0%（前一年 Q2 為 27.4%），InP 出口許可延遲為因素之一。
findings.source: Nasdaq/Motley Fool data-news: AXT Q2 revenue drops 36%

cyclical_prior_downcycle_behavior.note: 週期長度歷史規律（InP/GaAs 業界）未搜尋到獨立來源；僅有 AXT 自身 2019 與 2023 兩輪數據。2019 與 2023 的 GaAs 基板單價跌幅未取得。
